role: Prepare representative v1 support/contact review cases for manual 3D visual inspection.

selection_policy.floor_support: Include all three remaining floor support cases because they test whether legged support is missed by robust bottom percentiles.
selection_policy.soft_support: Include one borderline pillow-on-sofa case and one large negative-gap pillow-on-sofa case.
selection_policy.counter_support: Include both kitchen counter cases because they test local support-surface ambiguity.

inspection_questions: Is the relation visually plausible in the 3D scene?
Does the local point evidence select the intended support surface?
Is the failure caused by segmentation or instance geometry?
Does this relation need a separate rule subtype?

decision_policy_after_inspection.multi_scan_replication: Start only if representative cases can be interpreted without unresolved geometry-source ambiguity.
decision_policy_after_inspection.rule_revision: Revise support/contact subtype rules first if most selected cases are visually plausible but fail because of rule strictness.
decision_policy_after_inspection.data_issue: Do not treat v1 violations as annotation errors if the point evidence or instance segmentation is visually ambiguous.
